name: Dermatologist referral for bromhidrosis

lead: Bromhidrosis (osmidrosis) is foul-smelling body odor, often tied to heavy sweating that feeds bacterial growth, especially in the underarms. Getting a medical opinion aims to find the cause and treat it, so you smell cleaner without guessing.

Causes can include excessive sweating (hyperhidrosis) and, rarely, metabolic conditions such as trimethylaminuria, which causes a fishy odor in sweat, urine and breath. Sources advise consulting a physician when odor affects quality of life.

paras: People book an appointment with a doctor or dermatologist when odor persists despite good hygiene. The clinician can assess for hyperhidrosis or other conditions and may prescribe antiperspirants containing aluminum chloride.
Treatments for severe cases include surgery, which carries a risk of nerve injury according to the sources reviewed. Prescription antiperspirants can irritate skin.

angle.text: A clinician can identify why you have persistent body odor, such as heavy underarm sweating or a metabolic cause. Treating that cause gives you a cleaner natural scent.

lead: Bromhidrosis (osmidrosis) is foul-smelling body odor, often associated with excessive sweating that supports bacterial growth, especially in the underarms.[1] In looksmaxxing discussions, getting a medical evaluation is raised as a way to check for an underlying cause of persistent odor.

Body odor can signal disease, and related conditions include trimethylaminuria, a rare metabolic disorder causing a fishy odor in sweat, urine and breath.[1] Sources advise consulting a physician when odor affects quality of life.[1]

paras: Skin bacteria acting on apocrine sweat are the main source of odor, and diet, microbiome and genetics contribute.[1] Physicians may prescribe aluminum chloride antiperspirants; severe cases have been treated with endoscopic thoracic sympathectomy, which carries a risk of nerve injury.[1]
